title: rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs: Integer overflow in CoAP option number accumulation
description:
In has_oscore_option(), line 240 performs `opt_num += delta` where both are u16. If the accumulated option number exceeds 65535, it wraps around. A carefully crafted CoAP payload could cause opt_num to wrap to exactly 9, falsely triggering OSCORE detection and causing the wrong compression rule to be selected.

**Location:** line 240
**Category:** integer-overflow

**Fix suggestion:** Use saturating_add or checked_add: `opt_num = opt_num.saturating_add(delta); if opt_num > 9 { return false; }` - saturating at max means we'll always hit the >9 check after overflow.
close_reason: The integer overflow fix is already implemented. In has_oscore_option() (lines 397-485), opt_num is declared as usize (line 411), not u16, and the addition uses checked_add() at line 466-469 which returns None on overflow, causing the function to safely return false. No vulnerable opt_num += delta pattern exists in the codebase.
